title: T300 Printer Project roadmap
summary: Recovery-first path from stock printer to audited mainline candidate, then print-quality commissioning.

milestones.title: Owner sign-off on candidate design
milestones.summary: Review Dossier, migration guide, safety UI audit, Orca contract, and release gates before physical migration.

milestones.title: Recovery USB and full stock backup
milestones.summary: Recovery files are locally verified. Next, apply the owner-approved device-tree and recovery-overlay update to the USB, re-audit it, prove three serial-selected USB boots, then capture the full stock eMMC.

milestones.title: USB-boot mainline candidate with printer control disabled
milestones.summary: Validate screen, services, camera, storage, network, and permissions without motion or heat.

milestones.title: Attended hardware commissioning
milestones.summary: Owner initiates sensor, fan, endstop, probe, axis, heater, MCU-loss, and emergency-stop tests.

milestones.title: OrcaSlicer mainline profile and staged print prep
milestones.summary: Portable profiles and editable first-layer, bracket, and Frieren projects are staged. Final profile values and G-code exports wait for commissioning and per-filament calibration.

milestones.title: Print-quality baseline
milestones.summary: Run standard first-layer, dimensional print, camera bracket, and calibrated filament tests before Frieren.

recentChanges.summary: Completed live read-only hardware preflight, rejected kexec as the primary recovery route, and pinned owner-operated 1,500,000-baud serial U-Boot USB selection.
Found the recovery USB's missing explicit Klipad50 device-tree selection; staged the corrected file and refreshed recovery overlay locally without writing mounted media.
Built and validated owner-local v14 with private GerGo confined to maintenance mode; 338 repository tests and all eleven end-to-end validation checks pass.
Downloaded the complete official Comgrow 1.5.2 stock image, screen firmware, and integrated package into owner-only private storage; verified listed sizes, file structure, and SHA-256 hashes.

Pushed commit 891fa61 with the audited pressure-advance and extrusion policy, portable Orca profiles, large-format test, staged-project evidence, and a persistent warn-first hull/floor-line slicing rule.
Added bounded admitted-print pressure advance, retraction-credit accounting, cleanup resets, and a read-only Printer Status action; exact Klipper and policy tests pass.
Installed eight portable Orca 2.4.2 profiles and staged four editable review projects without final G-code; every provisional filament value remains visibly calibration-required rather than accepted.
Verified the requested calibration command forms against exact OrcaSlicer 2.4.2 source and added a pinned compatibility contract.
Recorded the post-calibration staging rule: camera bracket and Frieren remain editable until calibrated profiles are known, then accepted G-code exports are staged on the USB.
Added the Factorian/Orca filament-calibration order to the Dossier: printer baseline, temperature, max volumetric speed, pressure advance, flow ratio, then retraction/stringing.
Installed the reviewed T300 runtime Orca machine preset as this laptop's default for new projects and added a portable Linux/Windows/macOS installer for other Orca setups.
Added an explicit OrcaSlicer mainline-profile and Frieren-slice preparation gate after recovery backup and mainline calibration.
Prepared the backed-up printer USB as a verified Armbian recovery USB with the T300 recovery overlay installed.

Answered owner Agent Requests in the Dossier: G-code safety layering, concrete unsafe-behavior classes, print limits, cooling-fan behavior, advanced-control visibility, and USB-versus-network migration roles.
Pushed public printer project commit 0590c50 with mainline candidate, tests, docs, and Orca runtime profile.
Created data-only Dossier project inside the printer repository using Dossier Engine 0.7.0.
Disabled Dossier Engine origin push URL locally to keep it downstream-update-only on this laptop.
